  c_k = sum_(|I|=|J|=k) |det F_(I,J)|^2 product_(i in I intersect J) t_i

has only strictly negative real zeros (or is constant). In particular the
coefficient sequence is logconcave and has no internal zeros. Rationality is
needed only for the algorithmic corollary, not this algebraic theorem.

Combining this theorem with the current grandcanonical filtered-Slater
interface gives fixed-particle-number Born sampling and coherent preparation

rational fugacity search. This is a conditional algorithmic corollary: it
still imports Chen–Liu's new FPRAS and N63's shared-tape reversible compiler.
Neither imported algorithm was implemented or fully independently certified
here. The polynomial is very large; this is not a practical implementation.

external correctness and priority unresolved. The stability machinery itself

7 October 2026. Agent /root/paired_fermion_transfer.

external-field implementation that avoids irrational graph-matrix entries.
More substantially, the following charge-polynomial theorem was derived here:

  For every F in C^(n x n) and every 0<=t_i<=1,
    Z(s)=sum_(k=0)^n s^k sum_(|U|=|D|=k)
              |det F_(U,D)|^2 product_(i in U intersect D)t_i

An explicit cloned-column/chiral-matrix identity proves this using established
stability of Hermitian principal characteristic polynomials. It does not need
F real, symmetric, nonnegative, invertible, local, or well conditioned.
The theorem is internally proved here and independently checked by sibling
/root/canonical_bcs_audit. External correctness and physical-specialization
priority remain unverified. The stability/averaging machinery itself is prior
art; see Leake–Ravichandran below.

Consequently, CONDITIONAL on the already audited Chen–Liu homogeneous FPRAS

fugacity acquired from grandcanonical Born samples. This needs no inverse
original number-sector probability or inverse Gutzwiller norm. The filters may
